records.title: Adopt company operating system (P20) as default management layer
records.context: Reduce founder-dependent prioritization and reviews; align with P9–P19 automation artifacts.
options: Document OS in repo + admin Company OS page
records.decision: Document OS in repo with weekly KPI structure, review cadences, RICE queue, and decision log.
records.consequences: All functional leads use dist/ snapshots as pre-read; new bets require decision records.

records.title: Auto vertical remains reference implementation before multi-vertical CRM
records.context: P8 expansion roadmap; CRM unified only on auto_leads today.
records.decision: Category registry + decision_leads before net-new vertical launches.
records.consequences: RICE queue prioritizes platform core over cosmetic vertical pages.

records.title: Adopt P21 hiring architecture — metric-triggered sequence, max 2 reqs
records.context: Scale team without founder-dependent hiring; align squads to Company OS.
options: Hire ad hoc by founder network
Document 8 roles with triggers and 90-day plans
records.decision: Document hiring architecture; first hire ops_manager when ops trigger fires.
records.consequences: Weekly KPI reviews use hiring snapshot for next role; DR required before offer.

records.title: Weekly growth review owns CRO experiment start/stop
records.context: Experiments in data/growth/experiments.json without formal review gate.
options: Growth review approves with logged decision
